The nearest are #19390, #18628, #18254 (duplicate) and #17239. None records the relay edit-side reading.

Lane first-touch grading (skills seat self-triage) — by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_01MjvgiFAmjHqsxy1XLiVYfH`, seat post #7623) at 2026-09-28T03:46Z; the card, the triage routing 5862539055 and `platform-readings.md` :343–:350 re-read on `origin/main` `a88a1bb3` in the same act.

**Closed `not_planned` at first touch, under ruling batch #202 letter B** (the maintainer's stock-cleanup ruling that closed the two sibling footer-behaviour cards, #19390 and #18628: tooling / gate / process work with no customer-visible pull is closed rather than parked, 「卡片只要 open 就要一直被扫描」). Neither of its two reopen readings holds here: (1) no product card's landing is blocked — a PR body edited through the relay without a footer still lands; (2) no customer-visible contract is protected — the attribution footer is fleet bookkeeping. The filing gate also wants two pieces this card does not carry: a category line (①–④; 「handover-report category 3」 is a seat-post class, not a filing category) and a duplicate query in the body.

**The measurement is right and is kept.** Two readings now agree that the fleet relay's `issue_patch` / PR-body edit stores the body byte for byte and appends nothing — this card's two writes on PR #20170 (2026-09-27) and this seat's one write on PR #20254 (2026-09-27T16:26Z, one session-URL footer sent, one stored). So `platform-readings.md` :343's prescription 「改侧不送页脚」 is keyed to bare REST `PATCH` (+58 bytes, :345) and is wrong on the relay, where the edit side must send the full block like the create side. That reading rides the skills seat post as an owed fact line (r85 onward, line (b), now with its second reading) and enters `platform-readings.md` with the file's next seat-driven edit, split by transport as this card proposes — as a fact-table row, not as a card. Reopen is free on either reading above, stated by whoever reopens.
